issues.description: Method signature mismatch for Rideable.messageOnRide: the problem statement UML and the template Main expect a no-argument method messageOnRide():String (used in Main as r.messageOnRide()), but the solution defines Rideable.messageOnRide(String equipment) and implements that signature in Pig and Seal. This parameter-list difference prevents the template usage from compiling against the solution API and will confuse students about the required method signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Rideable.messageOnRide signature consistent across all artifacts. Either: (A) Change the solution's Rideable and its implementations (Pig, Seal) to a no-argument signature: String messageOnRide() and update their return strings accordingly (e.g., "Riding on Pig Doodle"); or (B) Update the problem statement UML and the template Main to declare and call messageOnRide(String equipment) (and update the example call sites to pass an equipment argument). Ensure the chosen signature is used in the UML, template Main, and all solution/teacher code so students have a single, consistent API to implement.
